issue.title: Specify native artifact export, loader and reference behavior for the learned path

milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
## Delivered specification — 2026-09-03

#1086 delivered **NATIVE_REFERENCE_CONTRACT_SPECIFIED** through [protected PR #1103](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/pull/1103), merge `93613bf82782ca78406fe2739dcc8d9e1d0f2b9e`. [Specification](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/93613bf82782ca78406fe2739dcc8d9e1d0f2b9e/docs/r4_native_reference_1086.md), [exact contract](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/93613bf82782ca78406fe2739dcc8d9e1d0f2b9e/docs/r4_native_reference_1086_contract.json), [independent review](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/93613bf82782ca78406fe2739dcc8d9e1d0f2b9e/docs/r4_native_reference_1086_review.md). Contract SHA256 `e3565728dfa872d9c260dd3d391ae59e0b0d454ebead20cd15cb075b24796115`.

The accepted DoD defines the 21-component artifact, trusted loader/admission, raw-byte request/result/state, actual f32/f64 operators, opt-in Rust ownership and a separate matched empirical bridge. Independent specification/operator and final delivery reviews accepted it; 55 focused metadata/source checks plus claim-wording/diff checks passed. Required GitHub statuses were transport acknowledgements, not scientific QA. Native implementation/export/loads/forwards/fits/comparison/replay/withheld access remain NOT_RUN. All prior measured, unavailable, weak-control and descriptive records remain unchanged; this supplies no mathematical proof or native capability result. Storage was reviewed without deleting evidence or user material.

This specification is complete. **Next: separately activate #1102**, currently parked and unassigned, to implement the frozen native reference boundary and obtain independent approval of its exact export/input/runtime release before new model work. #973 remains open, #954 blocked, and #1083/#1087 retain their separate typed-integration/final-lowering obligations.

## Historical accepted-reference handoff before activation — 2026-09-03

#1085's specification is delivered and #1094 now completed CLAUSE_ADAPTER_PRESERVED through [PR #1101](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/pull/1101), merge `eade29f4b78435e9857936786426bb34e596b301`. [Accepted raw-text comparison and exact fresh-process replay](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/eade29f4b78435e9857936786426bb34e596b301/docs/r4_retained_comparison_1094.md); [independent review](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/eade29f4b78435e9857936786426bb34e596b301/docs/r4_retained_comparison_1094_review.md). The native specification dependency #1085 is closed. This issue is eligible for separate activation and remains unassigned.

Next: freeze the artifact export/loader and reference-behavior contract for the unchanged reader/core, known vocabulary/query forms, four-fact context and exact accepted identities/operators. Define the smallest matched reference/native behavior check and resource envelope before implementation. The accepted 1,600-row result covers related renderings of 20 already-observed groups; it does not qualify new worlds, general language, generation, coding or final integer/table serving. Preserve #1079's weak control and #1082's descriptive limits; #973 remains open and #954 blocked. No port, loader or new evaluation was started in the #1094 delivery.

## Outcome
Connect an accepted learned reference to a truthful native Rust artifact/API boundary without conflating that reference with the final integer/table serving kernel.

## Deliverable and DoD
Define export manifest, tokenizer/frame identity, input/state/output schema, dtype/operator/reduction semantics, loader validation, capability metadata and supported operation. No fallback. Specify the smallest matched reference/native behavior check needed to establish the bridge and its resource envelope; implementation follows after the consumer schema is accepted. Historical R4G1 interchange is a separate adapter.

## Earlier ownership and next action at adoption
Planned native integration lane, unassigned and blocked by language/interface specification. Next: map the accepted reference's exact operators/artifacts to Rust ownership. Do not port the donor's canned replies or start a new runtime architecture by inference.
